exposure: Treatment throughout pregnancy (biologic disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (bDMARD) vs conventional synthetic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drug (csDMARD))
Spondyloarthritis (SpA) diagnosis (axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) vs peripheral SpA)
conventional synthetic disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drug (csDMARD) use
outcome: Delivery mode (Cesarean section vs normal vaginal delivery vs assisted delivery)
cohort: 57 pregnant women with SpA attending a specialized pregnancy and rheumatic disease clinic between 2016 and 2022
finding: Pregnant women with SpA experienced a high rate of favorable pregnancy outcomes, with no significant difference observed between those with axSpA and peripheral SpA.
mod_finding: This study on pregnancy outcomes in patients with spondyloarthritis found a high rate of cesarean deliveries (53%) but did not examine any association between mode of delivery and other outcomes.
